quests.title: A Meeting of "Puppets"

dialogue.t: This really is hard to believe. I never imagined I'd be sitting here drinking tea with you.
Is it really that strange? I just wanted to thank you for the core processing unit you provided for the numerological array.
And why do you keep talking like you know us inside out? You make it seem like you have a deep understanding.
I told you, I'm a good judge of character.
Still... Haha, you said it right. I shouldn't keep assuming I understand you.
Oh?
Even compared to our last meeting, I feel like you've changed a lot.
Hmph! It doesn't matter how far back you want to "compare," the only changes I've undergone are to accept the errors in my core and open my eyes to see a few things clearly.
And what about you? As a fellow "puppet" of sorts, do you ever experience computational errors in your heart?
Hah... I experience far more than just errors!
Do tell.
I don't think we know each other well enough for that just yet.
Heh, have it your way. I was merely asking out of courtesy.
Regardless, it takes a good many detours before a puppet can find its heart. At least, it did for me.
You seem to have a good relationship with your creator...
I did. He gave me a lot of help and guidance, both in life... and after.
In that regard, there's a fundamental difference between us.
...Oh. Is that so?
I'm sorry. Even though we share some similarities as puppets, I shouldn't have assumed to know anything about you based on that alone.
Don't worry about it. To borrow a phrase from you, I, too, have accepted my past errors.
It's just that I've taken too many detours already. I need to walk an even longer path to make up for them all.
In that case... good luck? To borrow a phrase in return, I don't know you well enough yet to give any further advice.
Haha... Well said.
We each have our own paths to walk. There's no need to say anything more. This tea is quite good, by the way.

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: Alright, goodbye.

quests.description: Go to Lambad’s Tavern, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Hat Guy…
